    Network Engineer (CDS) (Open For Freshers)

    LG CNS Việt Nam
    Sign in to view salary
    Apply now
    +2
    Tầng 15, tòa Keangnam Landmark 72, Mễ Trì, Yen Hoa, Ha Noi
    At office
    Posted 17 minutes ago
    Skills:
    CompTIA Network+ System Architecture
    Job Expertise:
    Network Engineer
    Job Domain:
    Network and Infrastructure

    Top 3 reasons to join us

    • Salary and bonus based on ability
    • Young and fun working environment
    • Opportunities to study and work abroad.

    Job description

    • Participate in the design, deployment, and operation of Global Network infrastructure.
    • Support daily network operations, monitoring activities, and CSR (incident and request handling).
    • Perform real-time troubleshooting and resolution of network incidents to ensure system stability and service availability.
    • Assist in network device configuration, routing setup, and connectivity validation across internal and external systems.
    • Support network changes, upgrades, and deployment activities under technical guidance.
    • Collaborate with internal teams using communication tools such as Wire to handle operational tasks and coordination.
    • Contribute to continuous improvement, standardization, and optimization of network infrastructure and operational processes.
    • Maintain, update, and manage basic network documentation, topology diagrams, and operational guidelines.
    • Follow operational procedures, security policies, and compliance requirements in enterprise environments.

    Your skills and experience

    [Required]

    • Bachelor’s degree (4-year university) in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
    • Clear interest and career orientation toward Infrastructure / Network Engineering.
    • Fundamental knowledge of networking technologies including TCP/IP, routing, switching, and VPN concepts.
    • Basic experience or strong understanding of network deployment, configuration, and operational support.
    • Ability to handle network incidents, service requests, and troubleshooting tasks with guidance from senior engineers.
    • Good communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively in a team-oriented environment.
    • Willingness to learn, improve technical skills, and work in enterprise-scale network environments.

    [Preferred]

    • Cisco network certifications such as CCNA or CCNP.
    • Experience or familiarity with cloud networking environments (AWS, GCP).
    • Basic Python or scripting skills for network automation or operational support.
    • Ability to communicate in English, especially for verbal communication (meetings or phone calls).
    • Experience working with monitoring tools or ticketing systems in NOC or infrastructure teams.

    Why you'll love working here

    - Best remuneration: Periodically review and adjust salary once a year, PI bonus twice a. Allowances for lunch, transportation, and phone charges. Party with the team once a. Workshop travel for the whole company once a year. Bonuses/Gifts for holidays, International Labor Day, International Women's Day, etc.
    - High-class, modern office: 5-star standard office with modern equipment, large rest and entertainment areas (game area, karaoke room, reading room, cafe counter, snack bar, etc.) Meet all members' needs, especially the office has an airy and beautiful view that is among the most beautiful in Hanoi.
    - Top equipment: Each employee is equipped with the latest generation LG Gram laptop and modern large LG screen.
    - Best working time: Work 8 hours/day (8:00 ~ 17:00), from Monday to Friday. No pressure to work overtime/weekends!
    - Flexible, youthful working style: LG CNS Vietnam members are mostly from the 9-10x generation, with a youthful, modern, and fair working style!
    - Creative environment, valuing individual opinions: With a young and talented team, we always appreciate the creativity and suggestions that members make.
    - Opportunities to work/study in Korea and abroad: With customers and projects mostly from abroad, your opportunities for training and onsite abroad will always be open!
    - Other: Happy hours every Friday, Team outing monthly, join clubs like football, badminton, etc...
